edits: manifest.yaml: a `construct:` declaration (identity, shape, members, references, rules, meaning) inserted after `roles` (or after `name` where the object type declares no roles) in each of the ten object types domain, entity, value_object, aggregate_root, nested_entity, repository, event, state_machine, process and enumeration (filament-core-data#172). `population` declares none and lowers to a record. The key is read raw from these bytes until quire-rs carries it on CompiledArchetype (agent-ix/quire-rs#445); the upstream declarations land in agent-ix/spec-objects-business and replace this edit when the pin moves.

manifest.yaml: two roles added so each declaration's references name roles, never object type names: `aggregate-member` on entity, value_object, nested_entity and enumeration (the types an aggregate root's members name), and `composite-owner` on entity, aggregate_root and nested_entity (the types a nested entity's owner names).
